description: Fork of exp071 with residual LUTs and DenseNet-style growing residual stream. Each LUTBlock i holds an additional residual_lut: (i+1)*E -> E with nap=6, tph=256*(i+1), applied to concat(x, *prev_x) and added to out_proj output. At layer 0 the residual_lut input is just x (E -> E, tph=256). out_dom and out_rank are removed from the in-block path; block outputs are real-valued sums (out_proj + residual_lut). Only the final block output passes through V2D -> D2V to rank-canonicalize before the MLP unembedder. Unembedder: LayerNorm(E) -> Linear(E, 4*E) -> ReLU -> Linear(4*E, VOCAB). Global concat across layers is removed.
